The mechanism you want is amend, which rewrites `8a4cfd3` in place rather than stacking a commit:

```bash
git add <the-file>
git commit --amend --no-edit
```

I stopped short of running it because I can't tell which file you mean — nothing on disk is a candidate. Two likely explanations: the file was never saved/created in this checkout, or you're thinking of a different clone (this is a sandbox copy under `.campaign/sandbox/w3/`). Name the path, or create it, and the amend is a single command from here.
